missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Холм' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'виднеется'. 'Высокий' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'впереди' locates it ahead.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Холм' is the accusative after 'на', marking the destination of the climb. 'Крутой' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Холма' takes the genitive after 'с' meaning from the hill. 'Вершины' is also genitive, showing the top as the vantage point.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Холме' is the prepositional after 'на', marking where the church stands. 'Старая' agrees with the feminine 'церковь'.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Холму' is the dative after 'к', showing where the road leads. 'Зелёному' agrees in the masculine dative.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Холмом' is the instrumental after 'за', meaning beyond the hill. 'Лес' is the nominative subject of 'начинается'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Холмы' is the nominative plural describing the landscape. 'Зелёные' agrees in plural, and 'вокруг города' takes the genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive of source. 'Холма' takes the genitive after 'с', marking the starting point of motion. 'Вниз' reinforces the downward direction.
Strategic focus: Instrumental plural object. 'Холмами' is the instrumental plural required by 'любоваться'. 'Далёкими' agrees in the plural instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Холм' is the nominative subject. 'Этот' points to a specific hill, and 'древний' is the agreeing masculine predicate adjective.
